definition: `NoInfinitePerSeEfficientCauseSeriesReading R`: every being is accessible under R (`∀ x, Acc R x`), i.e. R is well-founded in Lean core's sense. A being is accessible when every being that R-relates to it is accessible, so each being has an inductive (finite-depth) certificate built from its per se causes.
note: This is the formal reading the corpus already gives the Second Way premise (DEF-PER-SE-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-LINK); this record names that reading so it can be distinguished from the literal no-infinite-series reading. Sourcing it would mean a claim that 'procedere in infinitum' denies an inductive grounding certificate rather than only an infinite enumeration.
